title: Loop Low Wrap Bed
descriptionHtml:
One smooth line, all the way round. The Loop Low Wrap Bed is inspired by mid-century hotel beds: a single continuous upholstered band runs from the headboard around the sides and foot of the bed.

Key features

  • Continuous upholstered wrap around all four sides
  • Low headboard with rounded corners
  • Fully upholstered to the floor, no exposed legs
  • Mid-century style for modern bedrooms

Materials and build

Built on a solid wood frame and fully upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop, with no exposed legs. Made in the fabric and colour you choose. Free fabric swatches are available before you order.

Sizes available

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Standard Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Need a different size, headboard height or an ottoman storage base? Ask us about a bespoke version.

Mattress compatibility

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose.

Delivery

Free delivery to mainland UK addresses by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Let us know about stairs or tight access when you order.

Care

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot any spills straight away with a clean, damp cloth.

Backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.
